chapters.title: Dressed So Beautifully, Going on a Date?
chapters.content:
In the evening, Xu Zhen sent Shuangxu a message half an hour in advance, informing her of their arrival time at the hotel and the location of dinner.

It was a high-end restaurant, so Shuangxu changed into a more formal dress and applied light makeup.

After changing, she went downstairs on time. He Tingzhou's car was already parked at the hotel entrance.

Xu Zhen respectfully opened the car door for her. Inside the car, He Tingzhou glanced at her, his gaze pausing slightly when it fell on her.

The sleeveless dress was elegantly designed, with a simple and neat cut that perfectly fit her curves.

The color was ice blue, very clean.

As she bent down to get in the car, her feet were adorned with fine-strapped high heels of the same color, making her ankles look delicate and well-proportioned.

Her makeup was light, with nude peach lipstick, and she wore two lustrous white pearl earrings that peeked through her black hair.

After settling into her seat, Shuangxu realized He Tingzhou was looking at her.

He was used to being casual and didn't like being overly formal. After the summit, he had taken off his tie, and the top two buttons of his shirt were undone, giving him a relaxed and uninhibited look.

Shuangxu looked back, feeling that his eyes were particularly deep in the shadows of the car.

Her heart inexplicably trembled slightly under that gaze, and she was about to speak.

He Tingzhou returned to his usual lazy and improper demeanor: "Dressed so beautifully, going on a date?"

Because the restaurant he chose was formal, dressing formally was basic etiquette.

Shuangxu felt as if he was implying she had deliberately dressed up with some intention. She turned her face away and clarified: "This is my most ordinary dress. If you think it's too beautiful, that's because I'm naturally beautiful."

He Tingzhou let out a light laugh, which sounded like mockery to Shuangxu.

What was so funny? She was indeed beautiful.

But He Tingzhou probably didn't think so. He preferred the voluptuous and seductive type.

Like that beauty in the qipao, whose alluring glance could make one's bones turn to dust. Shuangxu could completely understand that—what man wouldn't like that?

He Tingzhou picked up the tie he had thrown aside and re-tied it.

Slowly tying a knot, he pushed it down to below his throat. As the car started moving, he said, "You look good in blue."

The restaurant was very stylish, with a band playing melodious violin music. The food was much better than the place Shuangxu had gone to the day before.

With work on her mind, she asked He Tingzhou while eating: "Which part of the flight control system do you have questions about?"

He Tingzhou held his chopsticks, picking out the small green onions from the stuffed eggplant one by one: "Does your company like to eat with work? Why not just eat the documents and save the money on a paper shredder?"

If it weren't for him suggesting dinner to discuss, who would want to socialize with the client after work?

If he didn't want to talk now, they would have to wait until after eating.

Shuangxu watched his patient actions. Last time, she had wanted to ask.

"You don't eat green onions. Why have them in the dish?"

He Tingzhou justified confidently: "Just because I don't eat them doesn't mean they can slack off."

...Fine.

By the time He Tingzhou finished eating and put down his chopsticks, Shuangxu had been waiting for a long time.

She took out the thick stack of documents she had brought specifically for this purpose, ready to face the client's questions head-on.

He Tingzhou looked at her, her mind filled only with work, upright and serious, and smirked: "Why are you just taking it out now?"

Shuangxu was stunned by his reversal: "Didn't you want to eat first?"

The waiter brought the bill. He Tingzhou took the pen and signed it. His long fingers were strong and powerful. After signing, he handed the bill back and looked up with a self-righteous curve on his lips: "Eating made me tired. Let's talk next time."

...

Client, client, he was the client. Shuangxu repeated this to herself several times, stabilizing her emotions before putting the documents back.

"Shuangxu?"

Hearing someone call her, Shuangxu looked up and saw Bai Qingmei waving at them from a distance before smiling and walking over.

"Sister Qingmei." Shuangxu looked surprised.

"Why didn't you look me up when you came to Longcheng? I know this place well."

"I came here on a business trip."

Bai Qingmei looked at He Tingzhou: "Did you come together?"

"No." Shuangxu said, "I came to inspect suppliers. Brother Jingzhou happened to be here for the Hydrogen Energy Development Summit. We just ran into each other."

"Such a small summit managed to get you, a great figure, to attend in person." Bai Qingmei said, "It seems Yun Dun has been quite idle lately."

He Tingzhou lifted his eyelids slightly, lazily: "Mind your own business. How about I give you the company?"

He was equally rude to everyone. Shuangxu immediately explained for him: "Hydrogen energy is a new trend in the energy industry. Yun Dun pays great attention to this sector."

"Oh~" Bai Qingmei's smile was meaningful. Before Shuangxu could decipher its meaning, she changed the subject: "Have you finished eating? Since it's rare to be here, let me treat you to some drinks!"

Shuangxu looked at He Tingzhou, afraid he probably wouldn't want to accompany the two women and was about to let him leave first.

Before she could speak, He Tingzhou misinterpreted her glance: "Is President Song in a hurry to return to the hotel? Is someone waiting for you?"

"No." Shuangxu said, "I'm not in a hurry to go back."

He Tingzhou casually stood up and picked up his coat: "Then let's go."

Bai Qingmei called a few close friends. Zhou Sheng'an came over after work, still wearing his neat and proper suit. As soon as he saw her, Bai Qingmei hugged his waist and called him "Brother."

Shuangxu turned her head and saw Zhou Sheng'an embracing her, such a serious and proper man, yet when he spoke to her, he was very gentle.

She watched for a few seconds before silently looking away.

Zhou Sheng'an took a glass of wine and walked toward He Tingzhou. Shuangxu stayed with Bai Qingmei and her friends, drinking and chatting.

They were all quick to make friends, able to drink and have fun. Shuangxu felt like a rabbit that had fallen into a wolf's den, pulled by them to drink quite a bit and even taken to the dance floor.

The music in the dance hall was deafening, shaking the floor. Amid the noise and the fumes of alcohol, she soon felt dizzy.

After telling Bai Qingmei, she left the dance floor first, making her way through the noisy crowd to the bathroom to wash her face and clear her mind.

After drying her hands and coming out, she bumped into a man and a woman in the hallway, locked in a passionate embrace. The woman's leg was lifted by the man, and the scene was quite intense.

This heated scene startled Shuangxu, freezing her in place.

The couple was blocking the exit, and upon seeing someone coming out, they showed no intention of stopping, completely absorbed as if they were in their own bedroom.

This was a public bathroom; people came and went in a noisy environment. Couldn't they find a more secluded place?

When she entered, there had been no one. Who could have expected that in just a few minutes, the path would be blocked?

Perhaps due to the alcohol slowing her reactions and the suddenness of the situation, Shuangxu was still in a daze, unable to avert her gaze. A hand reached from behind her, covering her eyes.

He Tingzhou's lazy voice came from above her head: "What dirty things are you looking at?"

chapters.title: I Drank Too Much
chapters.content:
Shuangxu instinctively reached out to grab He Tingzhou’s hand. Just then, the woman moaned, and she instinctively tightened her grip.

He Tingzhou’s hand was warm, perhaps because she had just washed her hands, and the coolness of the water made the temperature difference feel especially warm in her palm.

His hand was large, with knuckles that felt hard when gripped.

She came to her senses and quickly let go of He Tingzhou’s fingers, which she had been clutching tightly.

Her eyes were covered, and the sounds of the man and woman kissing fiercely drilled into her ears—no better than watching.

The man had already noticed someone was there. Seeing an exceptionally beautiful girl, and the man beside her even more handsome than himself, whether out of intentional show-off or some other psychology, he put in even more effort.

If she removed He Tingzhou’s hand from her eyes, she’d have to face that shameless, wild scene.

But maintaining this posture, with him covering her eyes while she listened to the live performance, seemed even stranger.

Shuangxu was at a loss, hesitating for a long time before turning her back to them.

Her eyes were freed from He Tingzhou’s palm. His dress shirt came into view—crisp, straight white, coated with a gilded texture by the bar’s deliberately dim, warm yellow lighting.

She looked up and met He Tingzhou’s lowered gaze.

Those eyes were as deep and unfathomable as a bottomless abyss. Realizing they were too close, she wanted to take a step back.

He Tingzhou hooked his arm around her waist without a word and pulled her back.

The sudden physical contact made Shuangxu stiffen all over. Her breath hitched, and then she heard him say, “What, you want to join them?”

“I would never.” Shuangxu felt unnatural all over. Her mind, soaked in alcohol, was dizzy. She silently pushed the solid arm away from her waist.

He Tingzhou tucked his hands into his pockets, maintaining his usual casual demeanor.

She stopped moving, staring at the spot on his shirt over his chest. She could still feel his gaze, like a feather, slowly tracing her face.

Every inch it passed left a mark.

He Tingzhou’s deep voice lazily fell: “Song Shuangxu, your ears are red.”

He shouldn’t have said that. The moment he did, Shuangxu felt as if her ears had been set on fire, the flames spreading upward fiercely, engulfing her face as well.

It wasn’t her fault, was it? What normal person could remain composed when forced to see such filth?

Oh, he could.

“I drank too much.” She forced herself to stay calm.

“Is that so?” He Tingzhou raised his hand in front of her, making a “three” gesture with his fingers. “How many is this?”

“…” Shuangxu opened her eyes and lied, “Three.”

He Tingzhou suddenly laughed, his entire chest vibrating with the sound. Maybe it was because they were too close, but Shuangxu felt the subtle tremors transfer over.

The restroom hallway was too narrow, half-blocked by that entangled couple. The remaining space was just enough to squeeze through, but she really didn’t want to get close to them, let alone say, “Excuse me.”

Without He Tingzhou, she might have been able to keep a straight face. But with him there, it only deepened her embarrassment.

He Tingzhou had a thick skin. Judging by his leisurely expression, he seemed to be enjoying the situation.

Shuangxu endured the awkwardness for a moment before deciding it was better to just go back to the restroom and wait.

But the way back was blocked by He Tingzhou.

“Can you move?” she asked softly. “I need to get through.”

He Tingzhou’s dark lashes half-lowered as he silently studied her for a while before stepping aside to let her pass.

She went back into the restroom. He Tingzhou lifted his gaze to the couple, who were so overcome with lust they had no sense of occasion. His indifferent expression carried a cold disgust.

“If you love performing so much, why not go on stage outside?”

The kind of man who got turned on in public was naturally shameless. He grinned lewdly, “If you like watching so much, why not bring your girlfriend over?”

He Tingzhou scoffed, his mockery unmistakable. “With what you’ve got? There’s nothing worth seeing. Have the decency to be embarrassed. If I were you, I’d have castrated myself at three to save the trouble of growing up insecure.”

The man’s fatal weakness was struck. His face turned green. One look at He Tingzhou’s height and build told him he couldn’t win in a fight. Humiliated, he could only pull up his pants, mutter a curse, and leave.

The woman, rarely seeing such an extremely handsome man, looked He Tingzhou up and down, then threw him a flirtatious glance, her eyes silky. “Handsome…”

He Tingzhou’s eyelids lifted coldly. “Clean up the mess. Then get lost.”

Shuangxu played a game on her phone in the restroom to pass the time. When she thought enough time had passed, she went out.

The hallway was quiet. The couple and He Tingzhou were all gone. She let out a breath of relief.

When she returned to the private room, Bai Qingmei and the others still hadn’t come back. She sat down and slowly sipped her drink.

At first, she thought she was only two parts drunk—sober enough to go straight to a meeting. But after sitting for a while, she started feeling lightheaded and drowsy.

She propped up her chin and nodded off several times. After that, her consciousness blurred.

Bai Qingmei called her name a couple of times but couldn’t wake her. “Is Shuangxu drunk? She didn’t even have that many drinks.”

Zhou Shengan picked up the bottle from the table and took a look. “She grabbed the wrong one. This one has a strong aftereffect.”

Shuangxu only heard what sounded like voices, as if separated by a layer of glass—muffled and unclear. Then she felt something tighten around her waist, pulling her away.

Her mind was like a pool of mud, but her will to survive was strong. She struggled and resisted with all her might.

Someone nearby seemed to be laughing. “She looks like such a quiet little girl, but when she’s drunk, she’s so rowdy.”

He Tingzhou pinched her waist, then looked down at his legs, which had been kicked several times. He tsked. “Terrible drunk behavior.”

He scooped her up by the back of her knees, lifting her horizontally into his arms and carrying her out.

Shuangxu only felt herself floating, bobbing as if adrift on the sea. Following her survival instinct, she wrapped her arms around the massive lifeline and leaned against it.

Xu Zhen was already waiting outside the bar. Seeing this, he immediately opened the back door of the car. He Tingzhou placed her on the seat, but as he tried to straighten up, her arms tightened around the back of his neck, clinging to him like ivy.

He Tingzhou braced his palm against the car door, maintaining his bent posture, and looked down at her.

She was fast asleep, oblivious, as if she were only hugging a pillow.

Behind them was the bar’s noise, the occasional passing car on the quiet street, headlights flashing by.

The car hit a speed bump, jolting slightly. Shuangxu groggily opened her eyes. Outside the window, the night was vibrant and dazzling, neon lights streaking past, connecting into a colorful film.

Her eyes blinked slowly. After closing and opening them a few times, her muddled mind gained a bit of clarity.

This angle…

This seat’s texture…

She suddenly tensed, turning her head in slow motion. She saw a sharp, well-defined jawline, then a towering nose, and a pair of deep, dark eyes.

“Awake, Princess?”

She recoiled like a startled cat, instantly bouncing off He Tingzhou. Her drunk-softened body slid down, but He Tingzhou propped his knee up, lifting her, and caught her leg to pull her back.

“What, did my leg suddenly grow thorns?”

---

chapters.title: Crying and Throwing a Fit, Insisting I Hold You
chapters.content:
The sudden movement was too intense. Her heart pounded wildly, making her already muddled mind even more chaotic—like dough being kneaded at high speed in a bread machine. Rational thought couldn’t form before being scattered.

“Why did you carry me?”

She accused him first. He Tingzhou replied, “Or should we go back and check the bar’s entrance surveillance footage to see who was crying and throwing a fit, insisting I hold them?”

Shuangxu’s brain was completely liquid right now, unable to tell if he was serious or joking. She immediately shook her head. “Not me.”

“If not you, then who?”

Shuangxu saw someone in the front passenger seat. “Assistant Xu.”

Xu Zhen: ?

What does this have to do with me?

He Tingzhou hadn’t expected her to shift blame even when drunk. “Do you think he’d dare?”

“I wouldn’t dare either.”

“Why not?”

“You’re too bad.” Shuangxu said honestly.

The streaks of light outside flashed by, illuminating He Tingzhou’s slightly raised brow. “How am I bad?”

Too many ways to count.

Shuangxu felt uncomfortable sitting on him. She tried to get up, her hand instinctively pressing against his chest for support.

He Tingzhou’s voice was low. “Where are you touching?”

She immediately pulled her hand back, apologizing as she pressed her hand against the seatback beside his shoulder. She had only managed to sit up halfway when her head hit the car roof. She let out an “mmph,” covered her head, and sat back down.

He Tingzhou: “Don’t move around.”

Strange sounds and rustling came from the back seat. The driver in the front gripped the steering wheel tightly, not daring to look back. His eyes shifted toward the passenger seat, where Xu Zhen remained composed and unflustered, as if nothing was happening.

Impressive. No wonder he’s the executive assistant—such stable mental fortitude.

Shuangxu’s skirt was a bit in the way. She clumsily climbed over the center console, making her way to the empty seat on the other side.

Fortunately, the car was dark, and no one could see her flushed cheeks.

Afraid she might do something to He Tingzhou in her semi-conscious state, Shuangxu fought against her drowsiness to stay awake.

The car stopped at the hotel entrance. She unbuckled her seatbelt and got out on her own. Her feet felt like they were stepping on cotton, her head heavy and her steps light.

He Tingzhou came over from the other side, looking down at her. “Need me to carry you?”

Shuangxu immediately steadied her mind, trying to solidify the liquid in her brain. “I can walk by myself.”

He Tingzhou only raised a brow, saying nothing.

She walked toward the hotel. Perhaps because her legs were too far from her brain, she could barely feel them. Each step was taken with great effort, one by one, unusually steady.

Good. She wasn’t that drunk. She felt her straight line was solid.

He Tingzhou walked behind her, watching her legs sway as if weightless, yet each step she took was as firm as a goose step.

Shuangxu was very careful on the stairs, but her legs seemed to have a mind of their own and weren’t very obedient. Her body swayed, and He Tingzhou reached out to steady her.

She pushed his hand away, refusing his help.

He Tingzhou withdrew his hand, tucking it into his pocket, and escorted her all the way to her room door.

Shuangxu lowered her head to search for her room card in her bag.

Hmm? Where’s her bag?

She patted herself down for a long time, then turned her head, looking at He Tingzhou with clear eyes. “I lost my bag.”

He Tingzhou feigned kindness. “Where did you lose your bag?”

“I don’t know.” Shuangxu’s expression was blank.

He mimicked her tone, dragging out the end. “Then how am I supposed to help you find it?”

Shuangxu started walking back down the hallway, eyes wide open as she searched the carpet. She kept looking all the way to the elevator, then took it downstairs to the lobby.

A staff member saw her drunk state and, upholding the five-star service quality, approached. “Ma’am, what are you looking for? Let me help you.”

“I’m looking for my bag.”

The staff member glanced at the man following behind her, then looked down at the white women’s bag in his hand.

“Ma’am, what color is your bag?”

Shuangxu’s head was spinning, but she looked surprisingly alert, answering clearly. “White.”

…

The staff member looked again at the strikingly handsome man—resident of the top-floor presidential suite, currently leisurely holding a bag while accompanying someone in search of said bag. He cautiously and tactfully asked, “Mr. He, do you need our help?”

He Tingzhou replied, “What do you think?”

The man understood and discreetly shut up and disappeared.

Shuangxu continued to search for her bag like a headless fly, walking out the hotel’s revolving doors, bending over to look in the grass, then in the fountain.

He Tingzhou followed behind her, pretending to be a good person. “Did you ask that fish? What did it say?”

Shuangxu gave him a are you stupid? look. “It can’t talk.”

He Tingzhou laughed. “Are you even drunk?”

“I’m not drunk.” Shuangxu immediately said.

But the act of bending over made the alcohol rush to her head. Dizzy, she sat down on the edge of the flower bed.

He Tingzhou supported her wobbling head with his hand. Instantly, as if leaning on a pillow, her entire head’s weight settled into his palm.

He Tingzhou held her head and asked, “Not looking anymore?”

“Can’t find it.” Her vision started spinning. She was so tired, she wanted to sleep.

“Then what?” He Tingzhou said idly. “You’ll have to sleep in the flower bed, covered in leaves.”

Shuangxu immediately shook her head, which made her even dizzier. She felt a bit nauseous and instinctively grabbed He Tingzhou’s sleeve. “No.”

“Oh.” He Tingzhou put on the act of a kind person, though he was thoroughly cunning. “Then do you want to come back to my room?”

Shuangxu tried to think, but her cognitive abilities were nearly exhausted. The porridge in her brain was barely stirrable. Only a thin layer of subconsciousness remained, which still recognized the man in front of her as He Tingzhou.

Then… it should be fine to sleep, right?

Her eyelids, which she had been struggling to keep open, finally gave in and closed. Leaning back against his hand, her last bit of vigilance faded with her consciousness. “Don’t take advantage of me.”

He Tingzhou raised a brow. “Aren’t you a little late saying that now?”

No response.

“Asleep?”

He Tingzhou flicked his wrist. She truly had no defenses, sleeping with her head pillowed on his hand, her unconscious head swaying with his movement, her soft black hair spilling over his palm.

---

Shuangxu was woken by her computer’s ringtone.

The heavy curtains blocked out all the light. She awoke from deep sleep, her mind still foggy.

Her body, following the sound, got out of bed, found her bag on the table, and took out her phone to answer.

A middle-aged woman’s voice came from the other end. “Is this President Song?”

“It’s me.” Shuangxu’s mind slowly cleared. “Who is this?”

The other person was polite. “My surname is Feng. I’m from Anyang Cryogenic Technology. We met yesterday at the summit. I’m very interested in your company’s liquid hydrogen drone project. I was wondering if President Song has time today for a face-to-face discussion?”

“Of course.”

Shuangxu set a time with her, jotted it down on a sticky note, and hung up. After sitting on the edge of the bed for a while to wake up, last night’s memories slowly returned.

She didn’t remember how she got into the car, but she remembered most of what happened afterward.

For example, when she woke up in the car, she had been sitting on He Tingzhou’s lap.

For another, how he had held her bag while accompanying her everywhere as she searched for it.

She was so ashamed of her own stupidity that she wanted to bury herself. She covered her face with her hands, wishing for a hole to crawl into.

After a while, she looked around. She was in her own room. She looked down at her clothes—still the same dress from yesterday.

Thank goodness. He Tingzhou hadn’t taken advantage of her.

chapters.title: Afraid You’ll Make a Scene When Drunk
chapters.content:
AnYang Technology was an established listed enterprise with deeper roots and a more stable style than emerging tech companies like Huifeng.

AnYang had once had deep cooperation with Yun Dun. The general manager was a capable short-haired woman. Thanks to He Tingzhou, Shuangxu (Shuangxu) had exchanged business cards with her at the summit yesterday, and Manager Feng had expressed great admiration for her during their conversation.

In the afternoon, Shuangxu was invited to AnYang’s headquarters. Manager Feng personally received her and took her on a tour of the factory.

She was a straightforward person. After reviewing Snow’s (Feixue) project materials, she decided to sign the contract on the spot.

Shuangxu was a little surprised: "Don’t you need to consider it more carefully?"

Manager Feng laughed: "It’s an honor for AnYang to collaborate on a project that Director He has set his eyes on."

With a big tree to lean on, it seemed she was benefiting from He Tingzhou’s influence again.

After signing the contract, Shuangxu took Big God (Da Shen) back to the hotel.

On the way, she asked, "I want to treat Tingzhou Ge to dinner tonight to thank him for his help. Do you want to come?"

Big God firmly refused: "I’ll just order takeout at the hotel."

Shuangxu expressed understanding.

Big God hesitated: "I feel like Director He doesn’t like me much."

Shuangxu’s lips curved slightly as she comforted him: "Trust me, it’s not your problem. He indiscriminately despises everyone."

She first sent a message to Xu Zhen, asking if He Tingzhou had any plans for the evening.

When they arrived at the hotel, Xu Zhen replied: [Director He has no plans tonight. He’s at the hotel now. Miss Song can ask him directly.]

Shuangxu was considering whether to go up and knock on his door or call him first.

While she was hesitating, she heard a soft, melodious voice: "I’m here to see Mr. He."

The voice was somewhat familiar, as if she had heard it somewhere before. Shuangxu subconsciously looked up and saw a graceful figure in a qipao standing at the front desk, exuding natural charm.

The front desk was calling the penthouse suite, looking respectful.

Shuangxu was stunned for a few seconds. The beauty in the qipao turned around, noticed her, and smiled softly: "Miss Song, what a coincidence."

"Hello," Shuangxu replied, looking straight ahead as she walked past her into the elevator, deleting the message she had been typing on her phone one character at a time.

When the elevator reached the seventh floor, she asked Big God: "Which restaurant’s takeout are you ordering? Is there anything good to eat nearby?"

"Aren’t you treating Director He to dinner?"

Shuangxu shook her head: "He probably doesn’t have time tonight."

In just a few days, he had specially brought a beauty all the way from Yan City to accompany him. She better not disturb his elegant mood.

But for some reason, she recalled last night, and then remembered the embarrassment of being rejected last time.

He Tingzhou was never a gentleman. He was a playboy who left his mark everywhere, with women throwing themselves at him one after another.

Perhaps as he had said, he didn’t play with his friends’ sisters, or maybe he simply wasn’t interested in her.

After staying in Lin City for four days and resolving the liquid hydrogen supplier issue, Shuangxu booked a flight back to Yan City for the next day.

At the airport, while checking in, she received a call from He Tingzhou.

He Tingzhou asked: "Where are you going? I’ll be back in Yan City in two hours. I can give you a ride."

"Not necessary," Shuangxu said. "Your private jet probably can’t fit that many people."

He was bringing a concubine with him. It would be awkward for her to tag along, and Big God was socially anxious.

The man’s voice was as lazy as ever: "My plane isn’t a motorcycle. How can it not fit? Did you buy a soccer team?"

"...I’ve already bought the ticket and am at the airport."

"Then you might as well transfer the ticket money to me," He Tingzhou said. "Why let the water flow to outsiders?"

"Then wouldn’t I be spending double?" She wasn’t stupid. "I have to go through security. I’ll hang up now."

When the plane landed in Yan City, Shuangxu came out of the airport to find Shen Yu’s car already waiting outside.

"Brother?" she said in surprise. "Why are you here?"

"Is it not okay to pick you up?" Shen Yu asked.

"Zi Feng Ge said you were going to Germany. I thought you had already left." She rarely took the initiative to contact Shen Yu these days. She had heard this news from Yue Zifeng.

"I’m leaving tonight." Shen Yu took her suitcase, and the driver loaded it into the car.

Shen Yu glanced at his watch: "There’s still time to take you to dinner."

Shuangxu felt a little embarrassed: "I’ve already eaten the airplane meal."

She used to think airplane food was inedible and would rather starve than take a bite, waiting to eat something good with Shen Yu after landing.

But being abroad, she had eaten more unpalatable meals and had lost her picky habits.

Shen Yu’s gaze was deep, lost in thought. After a while, he reached out and gently rubbed her hair, smiling slightly: "Our little Jiu has suffered."

It wasn’t suffering, just a letdown after being pampered like a princess.

The driver waiting to the side suddenly whispered: "Young Master He is coming out."

Shuangxu turned her head and just saw He Tingzhou walking out of the airport’s glass doors.

His hands were in his pockets, his suit jacket draped over his arm. Perhaps the sunlight was too harsh, but his expression seemed particularly indifferent.

Xu Zhen followed behind, pushing a suitcase, and politely nodded to Shen Yu and Shuangxu.

The car sent to pick him up was parked behind Shen Yu’s. As He Tingzhou passed them, his gaze swept over Shuangxu before moving on. His joking tone with Shen Yu lacked sincerity.

"Here to pick me up? Why didn’t you tell me in advance?"

"Yeah, I came specially to pick you up," Shen Yu laughed. "If you don’t mind, we can squeeze in together."

"I do mind," He Tingzhou said. "A few days ago, a drunk person clung to me and used me as a cushion for half an hour. My legs are still sore."

His lazy voice suddenly tightened Shuangxu’s most sensitive nerve.

Shen Yu assumed it was another romantic encounter and laughed it off: "Since when have you been so patient? You didn’t push her away and let her sit for half an hour."

He Tingzhou also laughed: "She held on tight. There was nothing I could do."

His tone didn’t sound particularly helpless; instead, it carried an indescribable depth.

Shuangxu’s spine stiffened, as rigid as bamboo, and seemed to become brittle. If He Tingzhou said anything more, she felt she might snap in two.

Noticing her startled look, He Tingzhou glanced at her and asked casually: "Does the little princess like to drink?"

Shen Yu said: "Her alcohol tolerance is average. She doesn’t really like drinking."

He Tingzhou said: "Maybe she didn’t like it before, but she might now."

This remark left Shen Yu silent.

In the five years Shuangxu hadn’t been by his side, many changes had indeed occurred—changes he knew nothing about.

"Not even now," Shuangxu said, her voice tense. She secretly glared at He Tingzhou, hoping he would take pity and stop talking.

"That’s good," He Tingzhou said, the corner of his lips curling into an ambiguous smile. With the concerned tone of an elder brother, he said, "If you can’t hold your liquor, you’d better stay away from alcohol. You might make a scene when drunk."

---

chapters.title: Gift
chapters.content:
Shuangxu’s tense nerves only relaxed after He Tingzhou got into his car.

Why had he said those things in front of Shen Yu?

Was he using this method to secretly warn her that if she took advantage of him again, he would tell Shen Yu?

This method was indeed effective, but she truly hadn’t done it on purpose.

She didn’t often drink herself into a stupor. Shu Yang said that when she was drunk, she was quite obedient—she didn’t cause trouble, just slept.

She didn’t know what had happened that night, crying and making a fuss, insisting on a hug—it wasn’t her style at all.

Shen Yu took her to a restaurant they used to frequent, ordering all her favorite dishes. After eating with her, he had to leave for Germany.

The Shen family’s car was waiting outside. Before sending Shuangxu into the car, he reminded her: "I’ll be back in a week. Call me if you need anything, okay?"

Shuangxu nodded: "Okay."

"Go home and rest early," Shen Yu said. "I have a gift for you tomorrow."

"What gift?" she asked.

"If I tell you now, there won’t be any surprise." Shen Yu’s eyes were filled with gentle smiles as he closed the car door for her. "You’ll find out tomorrow."

The suspense of a surprise was tantalizing. Shuangxu was still thinking about it before going to bed.

The next morning, she went to work. Nothing happened in the morning.

Near noon, she received a phone call. The caller spoke in a stiff tone: "Miss Shuangxu, your gift has arrived at the company building. Please come downstairs to sign for it."

Shuangxu was signing financial documents, holding the phone between her shoulder and ear: "Zi Feng Ge, what are you doing?"

Yue Zifeng dropped the act, his voice returning to its usual carefree tone: "You recognized me."

"You used your own number," Shuangxu said helplessly.

"Oh, my bad. My brain’s not working," Yue Zifeng called her. "Then hurry down."

"Wait a minute. I’ll be right there."

After hanging up, Shuangxu quickly finished signing and headed to the elevator lobby. Xiao Liao stretched her neck and asked: "Where are you going?"

"Downstairs to pick something up," Shuangxu replied.

"I’ll go with you!" Xiao Liao eagerly jumped up from her seat and ran to her side, justifiedly saying, "I’m afraid you won’t be able to carry it."

Shuangxu didn’t know what Shen Yu had sent, so she brought her along.

Downstairs, Yue Zifeng had been waiting for a long time.

He was wearing a cream-colored shirt with light gray trousers, leaning against the hood of a white sports car, arms crossed, head turned 45 degrees to the left, striking a pose worthy of a magazine cover.

"Wow!" Xiao Liao said. "So greasy."

Shuangxu laughed softly.

"Who said I’m greasy?" Yue Zifeng, with his sharp ears, ended his posing time. "You’re so young, yet you have no taste at all."

Shuangxu walked up, and Yue Zifeng held up a driver’s license: "Well, starting today, you can drive legally."

Her original license was from the U.S. and couldn’t be used domestically. Shen Yu had helped her go through the process of exchanging it.

"So this is the gift from my brother."

"Are you kidding? Your brother wouldn’t be so stingy," Yue Zifeng raised his hand and tossed something over. Shuangxu quickly caught it with both hands—a car key.

Yue Zifeng patted the sports car behind him: "This is the gift from your brother."

The usually composed Xiao Liao suddenly let out a piercing exclamation. Shuangxu almost jumped in surprise.

"Ah! Porsche 918! My dream car!"

Before Shuangxu could turn around, Xiao Liao’s figure flashed past her peripheral vision like an arrow, rushing toward the 918, touching from the hood to the rear wing. The starting price of this car was 14 million yuan. She had only seen it speeding by on the street, smelled its expensive exhaust, but had never touched it before.

"How much is this car?" she asked carefully.

Yue Zifeng smiled: "Fully loaded."

Shuangxu wasn’t as excited; her emotions were rather complicated.

She knew Shen Yu doted on her and had spent a lot on her since she was little. But Lu Mannan already minded her existence as a dry sister. At a time like this, Shen Yu giving her a car would only make things worse.

"Why aren’t you happy? Don’t you like this car?" Yue Zifeng pointed at Xiao Liao. "Look at her. She’s practically drooling."

"I like it," Shuangxu said, then suddenly felt a bit pathetic. Now, even when Shen Yu gave her a gift, the first thing she felt wasn’t happiness, but fear that someone would be unhappy about it.

Yue Zifeng, with his usually thick nerves, rarely showed such consideration. He smiled and patted her shoulder: "Don’t overthink it! Last time I came back, I talked to Mannan. If she wants to marry your brother, she first has to accept that he has a sister. If she can’t accept that, then their marriage is out of the question."

He genuinely liked Lu Mannan—the naive and lively girl was very likable, and she was He Tingzhou’s cousin, which made her family.

But in one’s heart, there was always a distinction between closeness and distance. Shuangxu was the sister he had watched grow up; the feelings were different.

It would be unreasonable to marry a new wife only to have his sister bullied.

Shuangxu was stunned: "Is it appropriate to say that?"

"What’s inappropriate about it? That’s exactly your brother’s intention," Yue Zifeng said. "After returning from Dongyu Mountain, your brother ordered this car. He wants them to know that you are Shen Yu’s sister. He is good to you, and no one is allowed to have opinions about it. If you had been here a few days earlier, this car would have been in your hands already."

Shen Yu had never said any of this to her.

After Yue Zifeng left, Shuangxu stood by the car for a while, holding the key.

Xiao Liao finished feeling the car all over. With tears in her eyes, she asked Shuangxu: "Does your brother still need a sister? The kind who can eat, drink, and spend money? Even though I’m in my twenties, I can still be adopted!"

That subtle emotion was dispelled by her. Shuangxu laughed: "No, my family can only have one treasure."

"Then can I be your treasure?"

"Depends on your performance."

Xiao Liao, like a loyal dog, came over to give her a shoulder and back massage. When they returned to the company, she was like she had been injected with chicken blood—full of energy. She not only stopped slacking off but also took the initiative to find work. She sat with her back straight, and her fingers struck the keyboard with vigor.

After work, Xiao Liao, with her own crossbody bag, happily sat in the passenger seat and fastened her seatbelt properly.

"My home is even farther than yours. It’s out of the way. Are you sure you want to give me a ride?"

Shuangxu methodically started the engine and drove the sports car onto the main road: "Aren’t you my treasure?"

Xiao Liao teared up again: "Woo, I will be loyal to you forever!"

Shen Yu giving Shuangxu a sports car couldn’t be hidden, and he hadn’t intended to hide it.

Those who didn’t know the details assumed that Young Master Shen was spoiling his sister again. Those who knew a little about the situation, recalling the incident at Dongyu Mountain, understood that this was his way of compensating his sister for the wrong she had suffered.

This car was given with such fanfare that it naturally couldn’t escape the attention of the elders.

Lu Mannan’s relationship with Shen Yu had been a bit strained lately. She used to talk about Shen Yu constantly, but ever since returning from Dongyu Mountain, she had seemed listless.

She didn’t contact Shen Yu and spent her days at home, hugging her stuffed cat, playing dead.

He Wenjun couldn’t bear to see this and took the initiative to visit the Shen family.

chapters.title: Boyfriend?
chapters.content:
"Mann and Ah Yu arguing like this isn't a solution. If it weren't for seeing how unhappy she is, I wouldn't have come to you about this either." He Wenjun sat in the Shen family's living room and got straight to the point.

"Young people arguing is normal. I originally thought Ah Yu was good-tempered, caring, and would give in to our Mann a little. I didn't expect that after so long, he wouldn't take the initiative to soften his stance and coax Mann a bit. Doesn't he know Mann's personality? When others play dirty, he shouldn't blame Mann for it."

The incident on Dongyu Mountain was easy to find out about, and naturally, He Wenjun sided with her own child.

Fu Yun was worried, but not to the point of turning against her own.

"Ah Yu has always had a good temper and never loses his patience with others. This time, he was truly provoked. In the heavy downpour, our family's Shuangxu was abandoned in the middle of nowhere. He searched all night before finding her. How could he not be heartbroken? Put yourself in her shoes—if it were Mann, you and Old Lu would probably have turned the mountain upside down."

That did make sense, and He Wenjun couldn't keep pressing the issue.

"Your Shuangxu seems quite well-behaved. Although she's not your biological daughter, she was raised in your home, and after so many years of affection, Ah Yu is good to her. I can't say much about that. But now—" He Wenjun paused subtly.

"I've heard some rumors outside. Of course, I don't want to look at Ah Yu that way, but isn't he a little too good to Shuangxu? Giving her a house, then making a big show of giving her a car. He's never been this attentive to our Mann."

This struck a sore spot for Fu Yun.

"He treats Shuangxu like a sister. You also know that Mianzhi doesn't care about her at all. Ah Yu has taken on the responsibilities her parents should have. Not only has he given her a house and a car, but he will also support her marriage in the future. Do you still not trust Ah Yu's character?"

"Of course I trust him."

With the conversation at this point, He Wenjun's anger also dissipated, and she changed the subject: "Shuangxu is the same age as Mann, twenty-two this year. Shouldn't we start arranging her marriage as well?"

Fu Yun arranged a blind date for Shuangxu.

When Shuangxu found out, the chopsticks in her hand stopped mid-air, and she was left speechless for a long time.

On the phone, Fu Yun said, "I've met him before. He's handsome and considerate. Since you're free tonight, why not have dinner with him?"

Shuangxu's voice was a bit hoarse. "I... don't have plans to date right now."

"You're twenty-two already. How can you not date at all? Look at your sister, Leyan. She's two years younger than you, and Aunt Cui has already started looking for a suitable family for her. Although girls don't need to rush into marriage, dating is still necessary to know what kind of person suits you."

Fu Yun's persuasion was gentle, or rather, carefully avoiding certain minefields.

Shuangxu couldn't refuse, nor should she.

If she refused, it would seem like she was still hopelessly attached to Shen Yu.

Her throat felt tight, but in the end, she compromised: "Okay. I'll go meet him."

The man's name was Wei Qian. His family background couldn't compare to the Song family's three generations of political influence, but since Fu Yun had carefully selected him, he naturally had his merits.

He was successful in business, having founded a thriving catering brand. At a young age, he already had a net worth of several billion, making him outstanding among his peers.

Wei Qian clearly liked her. After all, she was the daughter of a director from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, with the Shen family as a powerful backer. In terms of family background, he was indeed the one marrying above his station.

Yan City was no shortage of wealthy people, but in the face of true power, wealth was just a string of numbers.

And Miss Song herself was stunningly beautiful, so much so that he was captivated at first sight.

Throughout the meal, Wei Qian spoke eloquently. Shuangxu, with her excellent upbringing, listened attentively, occasionally smiling or exchanging a few words with him.

From Wei Qian's perspective, this meeting was very pleasant.

But from Shuangxu's perspective, this man was extremely talkative, going from his entrepreneurial journey to his views on the current international situation.

The only thing he didn't do was ask a single question about her.

Halfway through the meal, Wei Qian finally asked a question.

"Miss Song, forgive my boldness, but have you had a boyfriend before?"

Shuangxu hesitated for a few seconds between telling the truth and lying. She decided to maintain the persona of a playgirl she had fabricated earlier to avoid any contradictions in the future.

After all, no one could verify what happened abroad.

"Yes, I have."

"Oh?" Wei Qian asked, "What kind of person was he?"

Shuangxu glanced at him. "A man."

Wei Qian gave an awkward smile.

Shuangxu knew he was actually trying to find out about the man's background, perhaps for comparison or other reasons. But she didn't care. There was no compelling reason to answer this question.

Moreover, she couldn't come up with more specific details. Lies with details were prone to inconsistencies.

After finishing the meal, Wei Qian called the waiter to pay the bill.

The waiter with a bow tie bent down. "Sir, your bill has already been paid."

Wei Qian's expression froze, and his gaze suddenly shot toward Shuangxu. "You already paid?"

When a woman secretly pays the bill, it usually signifies dissatisfaction with the blind date and a lack of desire to continue contact.

In other words, she didn't think much of him, which made Wei Qian feel a bit embarrassed.

Shuangxu had gone to the restroom earlier, so she had the opportunity. But she was equally confused. "It wasn't me."

She asked the waiter, "Who paid the bill?"

"It was Mr. He." The waiter looked up in a certain direction as he spoke. Shuangxu followed his gaze.

At the long rectangular table covered with a white tablecloth, He Tingzhou was dining with several foreigners in suits.

They were discussing something, and He Tingzhou seemed focused. But just as Shuangxu looked over, he happened to glance sideways at her.

He had his long legs crossed, leaning back comfortably in his chair. The corner of his lips lifted slightly before he turned away.

Shuangxu didn't understand the meaning behind that subtle expression.

Wei Qian asked, "Who is that?"

"My brother's friend."

Shuangxu didn't want to say more, but Wei Qian had a businessman's sharp intuition. "His last name is He? That He family?"

Shen Yu's friend was likely someone of extraordinary status. And He Tingzhou's innate demeanor was one nurtured in absolute power. A man at the center of power exuded an effortless nobility, even in the way his clothes draped.

Before Shuangxu could answer, Wei Qian had already straightened his jacket and walked toward that table.

Shuangxu didn't have time to stop him.

"Mr. He, it's a pleasure to meet you." Wei Qian extended his hand with a warm smile. "Wei Qian."

He Tingzhou lifted his gaze and glanced at him, then naturally shifted it to Shuangxu, who was following behind.

Shuangxu frowned slightly, her eyes fixed on Wei Qian's back with a hint of impatience.

The young master seemed to be in a good mood today and actually gave Wei Qian some face by shaking his hand. "He Tingzhou."

He spoke while still seated, his composure rooted in his lofty status.

Shuangxu was annoyed that Wei Qian had taken the initiative to greet him, but since he was already there, she had to harden her head and say, "Brother Tingzhou."

"I often hear Shuangxu mention you. I didn't expect to run into you here today. If I had known you were here, I should have come over to say hello earlier."

Wei Qian glanced at her as he spoke, as if blaming her for not introducing him.

Shuangxu pressed her lips together.

She hadn't mentioned him at all.

"Is that so?" He Tingzhou seemed interested. "What does she say about me?"

Wei Qian was quick on his feet. "She says you're a good friend of Mr. Shen Yu and that you have a very good relationship with him."

He Tingzhou gave Shuangxu a meaningful look. "It is quite good."

She felt that look was full of mockery, making her face burn. Wei Qian was trying to flatter him, but he didn't know that her relationship with He Tingzhou was nothing like what he assumed.

His words made her seem like a vain woman who boasted about his name behind his back.

"Boyfriend?" He Tingzhou said lightly.

"No." Shuangxu didn't know why she was ashamed to admit it, pinching her fingertips. "A blind date."

He asked again, "So, are you in a hurry to get a boyfriend?"

Shuangxu felt her face was thoroughly lost. She didn't want to answer his mocking question.

"Brother Tingzhou, you're busy. We won't disturb you any longer."

She turned and left after saying that. Wei Qian smiled at He Tingzhou, then followed her.

As they left the restaurant, Wei Qian took out two tickets. "There's a musical at the theater tonight. Shall we—"

Shuangxu didn't wait for him to finish before refusing. "I'm tired. I'll go back first."

"It's not even nine o'clock. Do you go to bed this early?"

"Is that not allowed?"

Her attitude was noticeably colder than during dinner. Wei Qian quickly said, "That's not what I meant. Then let me take you home."

"No need." Shuangxu walked toward the parking lot. "I drove here myself."

After getting into the car, she didn't start the engine. She gripped the steering wheel in silence for a while, then leaned forward and buried her face in her arms.

After a while, she sat up straight and took out her phone to message Yue Zifeng.

[Zifeng, can you keep me company for a drink?]
